welcome.title:
Your life,
well kept
welcome.body: A private place for your important documents, accounts, instructions and more. So you and the people you care about are prepared, today and tomorrow.

phone.title: Set up your account
phone.subtitle: Your phone number and WhatsApp will get you started. No email needed.
phone.signInSubtitle: Enter the number of your Keeplas account. We'll send you a code on WhatsApp.
phone.label: Phone number
phone.reassure: Your number identifies your account. Passkeys protect access.
phone.emailAccount: I signed up with an email
phone.accountExists: An account already uses this number. Sign in instead.
phone.noAccount: No account uses this number. Get started to create one.
phone.createAccount: Create an account with this number
phone.passkeyFailed: We couldn't sign you in with a passkey. Try again, or use your number.

verify.title: Verify your number
verify.body: We sent a code to your WhatsApp number {phone}.
verify.resent: We sent you a new code.
verify.note: We only use WhatsApp for notifications. Nothing from your vault is sent there.

codeErrors.wrongBody: Check the 6 digits in WhatsApp and try again. {count} tries left.
codeErrors.expiredBody: Codes work for 10 minutes. We can send you a new one.
codeErrors.tooManyBody: For your safety, sign-in is paused for this number. Try again in an hour.
codeErrors.notArrivingBody: Check that WhatsApp is set up on {phone}, then ask for a new code.

passkey.title: Create your passkey
passkey.body: Use your face, fingerprint or phone PIN to securely access your account. Your passkey stays on this device and never leaves it.
passkey.failedBody: The prompt closed before you finished. You need a passkey to keep your vault on this phone.
passkey.errorBody: Your phone couldn't create the passkey. Try again, or tap Get help to send us the details.
passkey.screenLockBody: Keeplas uses your phone's screen lock (PIN, face or fingerprint) to protect your vault. Set one up in Settings, then come back.

vault.title: Create your private vault
vault.body: Your vault is created securely on this device and encrypted. Only you can access it.
vault.note: Your vault is encrypted on this phone. Its key is also backed up, encrypted, with your Apple or Google account, so you can get back in on a new phone.

contacts.title: Add trust contacts
contacts.body: Invite up to 3 people you trust. Any 2 can help you recover your account and confirm a death. This role does not give them access to your files.
contacts.warning: Without contacts or a cloud backup, losing every device and passkey may lock you out.

setupDone.title: Setup complete
setupDone.body: Your account is ready. Your information is safe and ready for tomorrow.
setupDone.contactsBody: Invite up to 3 people. 2 can help you recover your account and confirm a death.
setupDone.backupBody: Your vault comes back on a new phone with your {account} account.

kit.title: Your recovery kit
kit.body: Write these 24 words down, in order, and keep them somewhere safe. With them you can open your vault if you lose this phone.
kit.warning: Anyone with these words and access to your phone number can open your vault. Never share them.
kit.intro: 24 words that open your vault if you can't restore it from your Apple or Google account or with your contacts. You don't need them to sign in.
kit.replaces: Creating a kit replaces any previous one: older words stop working.

oneWay.title: If you lose this phone, you lose your vault
oneWay.body: Right now this phone is your only way in. Keeplas can't read your vault, so we can't restore it for you.
oneWay.understand: I understand I could lose everything if I lose this phone

attestation.title: Keeplas can't run on this device
attestation.body: To protect what you store, Keeplas only works on devices that pass a standard security check. This one didn't, so we can't create your account here.
attestation.hint: This often happens on devices that are modified (rooted or jailbroken), running a test build, or emulated. Try again on another phone.
attestation.whyBody: The check proves the request comes from the genuine Keeplas app on a real phone, so no one can create accounts with a fake app.

unlock.title: Unlock your vault
unlock.body: Your face, fingerprint or phone PIN signs you in and unlocks your vault.
unlock.failed: We couldn't unlock your vault. Try again.

recoveryKit.title: Open your vault with your kit
recoveryKit.body: This phone doesn't hold your vault key yet. Type the 24 words of your recovery kit, separated by spaces.
recoveryKit.invalid: These words don't open your vault. Check each word and their order.

cloudRestore.title: Restore from {provider}
cloudRestore.option: Your backup comes back with your {provider} account.
cloudRestore.body: Your vault key is backed up with your {provider} account. Restore it on this phone in one step.
cloudRestore.note: A WhatsApp code confirms it's you before your backup opens.
cloudRestore.noKey: This phone can't find your {provider} backup. Check that you're signed in to the same {provider} account, or use another way back in.
cloudRestore.failed: We couldn't restore your vault. Try again, or use another way back in.

phoneProof.title: Confirm it's you
phoneProof.body: We sent a code to your WhatsApp number {phone}.

lostNumber.title: Lost your number?
lostNumber.body: Move your account to a new number. Your vault stays locked until you open it with your backup, your 24 words or your trusted contacts.
lostNumber.seeRequestBody: Follow the request made from this phone.
lostNumber.withSupportBody: Our team checks your request. It takes at least 72 hours.
lostNumber.note: Keeplas never sees your 24 words or what's in your vault.
lostNumber.kitBody: Enter your old number and your 24 words. They stay on this phone: only a proof derived from them is checked.
lostNumber.kitInvalid: This number and these 24 words don't match an account. Check each word and their order.
lostNumber.newTaken: This number is already used by another Keeplas account.
lostNumber.requestBody: Tell us who you are. We compare it with your account, and for your safety nothing changes for 72 hours.
lostNumber.name: Your full name
lostNumber.messagePlaceholder: When you lost your phone, when you created your account…
lostNumber.requestNote: We alert your devices, your email and your old number. If someone else made this request, you can cancel it from there.
lostNumber.sameNumber: Your new number must be different from the old one.
lostNumber.inProgress: A request is already in progress for this account.
lostNumber.stepReviewBody: We compare what you told us with your account.
lostNumber.statusNote: Come back here anytime: this phone keeps track of your request.
lostNumber.notFound: We can't find your request anymore.
lostNumber.lapsed: Your request has lapsed. Requests last 7 days.
lostNumber.rejected: We couldn't confirm it was you, so we closed the request. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.

newNumber.title: Choose your new number
newNumber.body: Your old number can't sign you in anymore. Enter the one you use now: we'll send it a WhatsApp code.

numberChange.title: Someone asked to change your number
numberChange.banner: If it wasn't you, cancel it now.
numberChange.body: A request to move your account to {phone} was made on {date} by someone who says they lost this number. If it was you, there's nothing to do.
numberChange.wait: Nothing changes before {date}, and our team checks the request.
numberChange.cancelled: Request cancelled. Your number stays the same.

socialRecovery.title: Recover with contacts
socialRecovery.body: Two trusted contacts must approve. Keeplas then waits 72 hours before releasing the protected key.
socialRecovery.codeBody: Compare this code with your contacts by phone or video call. Never send it by message.
socialRecovery.requestBody: Your trust contacts are reviewing your request. You'll be notified when the approvals are received and the protection window ends.
socialRecovery.approvalsLeft: {n} more approval needed to restore your vault.
socialRecovery.windowBody: Your vault will be restored after 2 approvals and the end of the 72-hour window.
socialRecovery.expired: Your last request expired before it was approved. You can start a new one.
socialRecovery.rejected: {name} declined your request, so this recovery stopped. Call them to check it was really you, then start a new request.

home.subtitle: Your important information is safe and ready for tomorrow.
home.inboxBody: Items to sort will show up here
home.addNameFailed: Keeplas could not save your name. Check your connection and try again.
home.deletionBody: Everything will be erased that day. Tap to cancel.

legal.agreeBefore: By continuing, you agree to the

push.title: Turn on security alerts?
push.body: Keeplas tells you when a new device signs in, when someone asks to recover your account, and when a Life check needs your answer.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your plan, storage and preferences.

privacy.title: Privacy and security
privacy.subtitle: Manage how you access your vault and protect your information.
privacy.passkeyBody: Secure sign-in with your face, fingerprint or phone PIN.
privacy.pinBody: Add a PIN after biometrics for extra security.
privacy.kitBody: Prepare a way back in if you lose access.
privacy.devicesBody: Manage this device and your browser sessions.
privacy.rotationBody: Secure the vault after a suspicious device or recovery.
privacy.pinSheetBody: On this phone, Keeplas opens with your screen lock: Face ID, fingerprint or your phone's passcode. A separate Keeplas PIN is available on the web app, for computers.

rotation.title: Rotate encryption keys
rotation.body: Keeplas creates a new Master Key and owner identity, then re-wraps every item on this phone.
rotation.noRoot: This phone does not hold the Root Key. Create a new recovery kit first.
rotation.legacy: Some legacy files still use the old Master Key directly. Open them once to migrate before rotating.
rotation.note: Keep Keeplas open and connected until every item reaches 100%.

recoveryCenter.title: Recovery center
recoveryCenter.body: Prepare trusted contacts so two of them can help if you lose every device.
recoveryCenter.needTwo: You have {n} trusted contact with a Keeplas account. With fewer than 2, they can't help you get back in, so contact recovery is off for now.

vaultRestored.title: Vault restored
vaultRestored.body: Your vault is accessible again on this phone. Your old 24 words no longer work.
vaultRestored.renewBody: Your trusted contacts need a fresh setup before they can help you again.

approval.title: {name} needs help recovering access
approval.body: {name} has requested to recover their vault. Call or video call {name} and compare the code below to confirm their identity.
approval.verified: I verified {name} and the code {code} by phone or video call.
approval.cannotRead: You cannot read {name}'s files. Approval only restores their access.
approval.failedBody: Keeplas could not seal your approval on this phone. Check your connection and try again.
approval.mismatchBody: Your screen shows the code below. If {name} reads you something different, someone else may be asking for their vault.
approval.dontApproveBody: Even if the caller insists or sounds rushed.
approval.callBackBody: Use a number you already had, not one given in this call.
approval.stillDifferentBody: {name} gets a security alert and the request stops.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Every device and browser that can open your vault.
devices.removeBody: It's signed out and can't sign in again without a new link from this phone.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.body: Open Keeplas on your computer, then scan its QR code.
scan.invalidBody: Scan the QR code shown by Keeplas on your computer.
scan.expiredBody: Codes work for 2 minutes. Refresh the page on your computer to get a new one.
scan.cameraOffBody: Allow the camera to scan QR codes and capture documents.
scan.failedTitle: This browser couldn't be logged in
scan.failedBody: Check your connection, then scan the code again. If it keeps failing, refresh the page on your computer to get a new code.

linkBrowser.confirmTitle: Confirm it's you to log this browser in

connected.title: You're logged in
connected.body: Keeplas is now open in this browser. Log out anytime from your phone.
connected.notified: A notification was sent to your other devices.
connected.manageBody: See and end your browser sessions.

blocked.title: We stopped this link
blocked.body: The key in this QR code doesn't match your account. Nothing was shared and no browser was linked.
blocked.warning: This can mean someone between you and Keeplas is trying to read your vault. Don't retry on this network.
blocked.whatBody: The QR code holds a fingerprint of your computer's key. Keeplas sent a different key, so sharing your vault with it could hand it to someone else. We stopped before anything left this phone.

newDevice.title: New device detected
newDevice.body: A sign-in to your account was detected on {device}.

notMe.title: Let's lock this down
notMe.body: We'll cut off {device} ({time}) right now. Here's what happens when you continue:
notMe.removeBody: It's signed out and can't sign in again.
notMe.sessionsBody: Any open vault on that device closes at once.
notMe.rotateBody: Your vault is re-encrypted. Other devices will ask you to unlock again.
notMe.note: Your trusted contacts are not alerted. You can review who has access right after.

secured.title: Your account is secure
secured.body: The unknown device has no access anymore. Here's what we did:
secured.keysPendingBody: Rotate your keys now to re-encrypt your vault on this phone.
secured.note: Your other devices will ask you to unlock again. That's expected.

migration.title: Move your account to your phone
migration.body: Keeplas now signs you in with your phone and a passkey, no password. It takes about 3 minutes.
migration.passkeyStepBody: Your face, fingerprint or phone PIN replaces your password
migration.appStepBody: Your vault moves to this phone
migration.offStepBody: We do it for you once steps 1 to 4 are done
migration.note: Your vault and trusted contacts stay exactly as they are.
migration.doneBody: Your account now lives on this phone. Your old password no longer works anywhere.
migration.doneNote: On a computer, sign in by scanning a QR code with this phone.

totp.title: Enter your authenticator code
totp.body: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for Keeplas.
totp.wrong: That code didn't work. Check your authenticator app and try again.
totp.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.

totpRecovery.title: Lost your authenticator app?
totpRecovery.body: Open your vault on this phone and we'll turn off the authenticator code. You can set up a new one later in Settings.

email.title: Sign in with your email
email.body: For accounts created on the web. You'll then move your account to this phone.

capture.photoBody: Take a photo or choose one
capture.voiceEncrypted: Encrypted on your device. Your voice note is encrypted before it leaves your device.
capture.localEncryption: Title, notes, category and attachments are encrypted on this phone.

securing.title: Securing your item
securing.encryptingBody: Turning your file into a secure format…
securing.uploadingBody: Sending a secure copy to your Keeplas storage… {pct}%
securing.uploadedBody: The encrypted copy is in your Keeplas storage.
securing.offlineBody: You're offline. The encrypted copy is safe on this phone and uploads as soon as you're back online.
securing.failedBody: The upload stopped. Your encrypted copy is still safe on this phone. Check your connection, then try again.
securing.quotaBody: Your storage is full. Free up space, then try again.
securing.protectedBody: Your item is encrypted and safely stored.

capture.noCameraVideoBody: Keeplas can't open a camera here (this device has none). Choose a video from your library instead.
capture.noCameraPhotoBody: Keeplas can't open a camera here (this device has none). Choose a photo from your library instead.
capture.folderKeyBody: Keeplas couldn't verify {name}'s encryption key, so the item wasn't saved. Check your connection and try again, or choose No folder and move it later.
capture.resetBody: Your {time} recording will be deleted from this phone and you can record again. This cannot be undone.
capture.addNoteHint: Your trusted people will see this note with the document.
capture.chooseItemBody: The pages and files are added to this item.
capture.encryptedTogether: Pages, note and attachments are encrypted together on this device.
capture.noteEncrypted: Your note and attachments are encrypted on this device before upload.
capture.neverSees: Encrypted on your phone before it is uploaded. Keeplas never sees the file.
capture.autoUnavailableBody: This phone cannot open the automatic document scanner. Take each page with the camera instead.

permissions.cameraBody: Allow camera access to scan documents and QR codes.
permissions.photosBody: Allow photo access to add images to your vault.
permissions.microphoneBody: Allow microphone access to record voice notes.

item.title: Item details
item.missingBody: It may have been deleted on another device, or it belongs to another account. Go back to your vault to see what's there now.
item.lockedTitle: This item can't be unlocked on this phone
item.lockedBody: Its key doesn't match the vault key on this phone, so Keeplas can't decrypt it here. Tap Lock vault, unlock with Face ID or your fingerprint, then open this item again. If it still fails, contact support with the reference below.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: This file is stored encrypted online. Connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again.

missing.title: This file isn't available
missing.body: It may have been deleted, or its upload never finished on the device that added it. Open the item on that device to upload it again.

decrypt.title: This file can't be decrypted on this phone
decrypt.body: The file doesn't match this vault's key, or it was damaged during upload. Tap Lock vault, unlock again, then retry. If it still fails, contact support with the reference below.

space.title: Not enough space on this phone
space.body: Keeplas needs room to open a temporary decrypted copy. Free up some storage, then try again.

unknown.title: This file couldn't be opened
unknown.body: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support with the reference below.

item.pdfErrorBody: It may be damaged or protected with a password. Share it to open it in an app that can unlock it.
item.textError: This text file couldn't be read. It may use an unsupported encoding.
item.noPreview: Keeplas can't show {type} files yet. Share it to open it in another app.
item.shareBody: Choose the trusted contacts who can open this item. Keeplas encrypts it for each of them on this phone.
item.shareNobody: No trusted contact has joined Keeplas yet. Invite someone first.
item.shareFailedBody: Keeplas could not encrypt this item for everyone you chose. Check your connection, or check that each contact's security code is verified, then try again.
item.archivedOn: Archived on {date}. It is no longer in your vault or passed on to anyone.

people.title: Trusted people
people.body: Set up the people who can help you and receive selected content, now or later.
people.addBody: Choose their role and how to invite them.
people.name: Name
people.trustBody: Help you recover access to your Keeplas account and confirm a death if needed.
people.beneficiariesBody: Receive selected content after you're gone. Assign items now or later.
people.beneficiariesLine: You choose which items they can receive.
people.trustScreenBody: These people can help you recover access and confirm a death.
people.readyBody: At least 2 of 3 contacts are needed to recover your account.
people.replaceNote: Replacing a contact renews recovery protection for your account.
people.replaceBody: {name} will no longer be able to help you recover your account. You can then invite someone new.
people.removeBody: {name} will no longer be able to help you recover your account.
people.beneficiariesScreenBody: They receive only the content you assign them, through the folders you share.
people.noBeneficiaries: No beneficiaries yet. Share a folder to choose what someone receives.
people.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
people.maxReached: You already have 3 trust contacts. Replace one to invite someone new.
people.alreadyInvited: This person is already one of your contacts.
people.inviteFailed: The invitation couldn't be sent. Check your connection and try again.
people.roleTrustBody: Can help you recover access and confirm a death if needed.
people.roleTrustFull: You already have 3 trust contacts. Replace one to add another.
people.roleBeneficiaryBody: Can receive selected content after you're gone.
people.permRecovery: Can help recovery and confirm a death.
people.permReceive: Can receive only the items you assign, after you're gone.
people.permIndependent: These permissions are independent of each other.

folders.title: Folder
folders.newBody: Folder names are encrypted like the items inside them.
folders.name: Folder name
folders.shareScreenBody: Give specific people access to a folder.
folders.waiting: Waiting for them to accept your invitation
folders.scopeHint: They will only see the items in this folder.
folders.timingNowBody: Give access as soon as they accept.
folders.timingLaterBody: Two trust contacts must confirm, followed by a 72-hour grace period.
folders.noneAccepted: Nobody can receive this folder yet. People appear here once they accept your invitation.
folders.nobody: Invite someone first. Once they accept, you can share this folder with them.
folders.nameMissing: This folder's name couldn't be read on this phone. Lock and unlock your vault, then try again.
folders.shareFailed: Access for {name} couldn't be created. Check your connection and try again.
folders.accessBody: Manage who can access this folder.
folders.nobodyYet: Only you can open this folder for now.
folders.revokeBody: {name} will no longer be able to open this folder. Copies already saved cannot be removed.
folders.revokeNote: Revoking a contact prevents future access. Copies already saved cannot be removed.
folders.addExistingBody: Choose items from your vault to move into {name}.
folders.addExistingFailed: {name} couldn't be added. Check your connection and try again.
folders.nothingToAdd: Every item is already in this folder.

search.label: Search your vault
search.empty: No encrypted items match this search.

lifeCheck.title: Life check
lifeCheck.body: Choose how often Keeplas should ask you to check in.
lifeCheck.paused: Check-ins are paused. Your countdown resumes once Life check is back on.
lifeCheck.resetBody: Only your answer resets the countdown. Using the app doesn't.
lifeCheck.confirmedBody: Your countdown starts over. Next Life check on {date}.
lifeCheck.note: If you miss the check-in window, your contacts are asked to confirm before anything is released.

prompt.title: Are you okay?
prompt.body: This is your regular life check. If we don't hear from you, we'll check again later before taking any further steps.
prompt.footer: A missed check never releases your information.
prompt.failed: We couldn't record your answer. Check your connection and try again.
prompt.missedBody: You didn't answer your last life check. Nothing is shared yet. Let us know you're here.

backup.title: Cloud backup
backup.bodyShort: Encrypted recovery in your cloud keychain
backup.body: Keeplas stores an encrypted envelope. The key is kept separately in your synced platform keychain.
backup.protected: Your backup is protected by your {account} account. Keep it secure with a strong password and two-factor authentication, and your Keeplas backup stays safe too. Restoring it also asks for a code sent to your WhatsApp.
backup.noRootKey: This phone cannot create a cloud backup. Create a new recovery kit first.

invite.title: You've been invited
invite.from: {name} invited you to become a trusted contact. You can help with recovery, but you cannot read their vault.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired, or has already been answered.

selfTest.title: Crypto self-test
selfTest.body: Runs the shared test vectors on this device's native crypto engines.

vaultList.emptyBody: Add your first document, account or note. It’s encrypted before it leaves your phone.

shared.title: Shared with me
shared.body: Folders shared with you by trusted people.
shared.emptyBody: When someone makes you a trusted contact, their shared items appear here.
shared.later: Access after verification. Requires two trust-contact confirmations.

passkeys.subtitle: Passkeys let you sign in with your face, fingerprint or phone PIN. Tap one to remove it.
passkeys.none: No passkey yet. Add one so you can sign in without a code.
passkeys.add: Add a passkey on this phone
passkeys.removeBody: You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey.
passkeys.removeLastBody: This is your last passkey. You will sign in with a code sent to your phone until you add another one.
passkeys.removeFailed: Keeplas could not remove this passkey. Check your connection and try again.

activity.subtitle: Sign-ins, devices and changes to your vault, newest first.

lostAccess.title: Lost access to your vault?
lostAccess.body: You can safely recover your vault using one of the options below.
lostAccess.contactsBody: Request approval from your trusted contacts (if configured).
lostAccess.kitBody: Enter your 24 words if you exported a recovery kit.
lostAccess.note: A phone verification code cannot unlock your vault.
lostAccess.deviceBody: Approve from a phone where you’re already signed in.

succession.title: Set up your succession plan
succession.body: Make sure your important information is accessible to the right people, at the right time.
succession.remindersBody: We'll remind you periodically to keep your information up to date.
succession.contactsBody: Both contacts must confirm before any access is granted.
succession.graceBody: A waiting period gives you time to respond if needed.
succession.assignedBody: Your trust contacts can access only the content you've assigned to them.

itemActions.archiveBody: It leaves your vault and is no longer passed on to anyone. It stays whole in Settings → Archives, with its history, and you can restore it at any time.
itemActions.archiveFailed: Keeplas could not archive this item. Check your connection and try again.
itemActions.moveFailed: Keeplas could not move "{title}". Check your connection, or check that everyone in the folder has a verified security code.

export.title: Export my data
export.body: Keeplas decrypts your vault on this phone and puts everything in one ZIP archive you can keep or move to another app.
export.keepOpen: Keep Keeplas open until it finishes.
export.ready: Your archive is ready ({size}). Save it to Files or share it. Your vault stays exactly as it is: only this temporary copy of the archive is cleared from Keeplas when you leave this screen.
export.failed: The export stopped before the end. Check your connection and try again. Nothing was sent anywhere.
export.warning: The archive is not encrypted. Anyone who gets the file can read it: keep it somewhere safe and delete it when you no longer need it.

contents.filesBody: Documents, photos, voice notes and videos, as added
contents.notesBody: Each note as a page you can open in a browser

export.skipped: {n} item(s) could not be opened on this phone and are not in the archive. Try exporting from the web app to include them.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.rowBody: Erase your account and everything in it
deleteAccount.body: Your account and everything in your vault will be erased from Keeplas for good, 7 days after you confirm.

loses.items: Every item, note and file in your vault
loses.shares: What you share with your trusted contacts, and what they can open
loses.succession: Your succession plan, Life check and contact recovery
loses.plan: Your plan. A Lifetime purchase is not refunded

deleteAccount.exportHint: to keep a copy of everything before it is erased.
deleteAccount.graceNote: You have 7 days to change your mind: cancel the deletion from this screen. After that, nothing can be recovered, not even by Keeplas.
deleteAccount.scheduledBody: Everything will be erased for good on {date}. Until then you can still use Keeplas and cancel the deletion.
deleteAccount.failed: Keeplas could not save your request. Check your connection and try again.

pin.label: Keeplas code
pin.sheetBody: This phone asks for your 6-digit code before opening your vault keys.
pin.unlockBody: Enter your 6-digit code, then confirm with your face or fingerprint.
pin.wrong: Wrong code. {n} more tries before a 1-minute pause.
pin.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {seconds} s.
pin.wipedTitle: Your vault key was removed from this phone
pin.wipedBody: After 10 wrong codes Keeplas removes the key from this phone to protect it. Your vault is safe: open it again with your 24 words.
pin.body: Add a 6-digit code after Face ID or your fingerprint. Both are then needed to open your vault on this phone.
pin.statusOn: A Keeplas code is set on this phone.
pin.statusOff: No Keeplas code on this phone: your screen lock alone opens the vault.
pin.mismatch: The two codes are different. Choose your code again.
pin.failed: Keeplas could not save your code. Try again.
pin.forgot: Forgot your code? After 10 wrong tries, Keeplas removes the key from this phone and you open your vault again with your 24 words.

importArchive.title: Import an archive
importArchive.rowBody: Add the items of a Keeplas export
importArchive.body: Choose a ZIP made with "Export my data". Keeplas reads it on this phone, encrypts every item again and adds it to your vault.
importArchive.notes: Imported items are added to what you already have: importing the same archive twice creates duplicates. Sharing with contacts is not restored, and each item gets today’s date.
importArchive.done: {n} item(s) added. Their files upload in the background; you can follow them on Home.
importArchive.skippedFiles: {n} file(s) could not be read from the archive and were left out.
importArchive.notKeeplas: This file is not a Keeplas export. Choose the ZIP made with "Export my data", without unzipping and zipping it again.
importArchive.failed: The import stopped before the end. Items already added stay in your vault. Check your storage and try again.

linkDevice.title: Use another signed-in phone
linkDevice.body: Your other phone sends your vault key to this one, encrypted end to end. Keeplas never sees it.
linkDevice.step1: Open Keeplas on the phone where you’re signed in.
linkDevice.opening: Opening your vault on this phone…
linkDevice.expired: The code expired before it was approved. Generate a new one.
linkDevice.rejected: The other phone declined. If it wasn’t you, secure your account from that phone.
linkDevice.failed: This phone couldn’t be linked. Check your connection, then generate a new code.
linkDevice.note: Only a phone already signed in to your account can approve this code.

itemEdit.title: Edit
itemEdit.historyNote: The current version is kept in the history, with its files. Nothing is lost.
itemEdit.failedBody: Keeplas could not save your changes. Check your connection and try again.

itemHistory.title: History
itemHistory.body: Every edit keeps the previous version, encrypted on your devices. You can read it or restore it.
itemHistory.restoreBody: The item goes back to its content of {date}. The current version is kept in the history.

archives.title: Archives
archives.rowBody: Items taken out of the vault, kept with their history
archives.body: An archived item is no longer in your vault and is not passed on to anyone. It stays whole, with its files and history. Only deleting your account erases it.
archives.space: Archives and history use {size} of your storage.
archives.restoreBody: Put it back in the vault, with its sharing
archives.restoreFailed: Keeplas could not restore this item. Check your connection and try again.
archives.emptyBody: Items you archive will show up here, with their history.
